about.label: About Nisha
about.title: Beauty is a language I was born to speak.
about.para1: I'm Nisha Syed, a professional makeup artist based in Vikravandi, Tamil Nadu, with over a decade of experience creating looks that feel both timeless and unforgettable. From intimate ceremonies to grand wedding celebrations, I bring out the best in every face.
about.para2: I believe every occasion deserves beauty that lasts — whether it's a luminous bridal glow, a radiant engagement look, or a joyful baby shower. Let me be part of your most beautiful moments.
